name: uppercase R resolves to the R lexer, not the lowercase r entry
description: The Pygments alias table is case-sensitive: 'R' is the R language while 'r' is REBOL. Phorge's getLanguageFromFilename() passes the filename extension through with its original case, so a file named foo.R really does arrive here as 'R'. Lowercasing the language before the table lookup silently resolved it to the REBOL entry, which Chroma has no lexer for, leaving R files unhighlighted. Pair this with render-language-case-lowercase.json: together they pin that the two names reach different lexers.
